MINUTES OF THE RESOLUTIONS PASSED BY THE SOLE DIRECTOR OF ZAMEEN NORD (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) ON THIS 1 9 TH DAY OF AUGUST 2021 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 Resolved that , the Company be and is hereby authorized to avail a loan in the principal amount of Rs. 204 ,000,000 (Rupees two hundred and four million) from Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited. 
 
 Resolved further that , Zeeshan Ali Khan be and is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds, and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transactions.
